text:
sara-partners: Heads-up: kicking off AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing onboarding. Need to align on initial permissions, legal artifacts, and product packaging. Please react with what you own.
aj-devrel: I can own packaging + validation. Need hero screenshots and a 1-liner by Wed. :thumbsup:
kevin-legal: I need to review EULA + reseller clause. Will provide a redline by EOD Tue. Who owns the GTM copy?
vivian-product: I'll take GTM copy. Also we should decide trial policy (seat vs time). Proposal: 14-day trial + metered usage for paid tiers.
liam-ops: For infra we need: staging S3 bucket for artifacts, publisher IAM role ARN, and a KMS key for AMI/images. Sample minimal S3 policy to expect from publisher:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace/*"}]
}
```
marketplace-bot: Reminder: publisher portal template v2 is live. Run `./scripts/publish_validate.sh --offer` to validate the manifest.
sara-partners: @kevin-legal does the reseller/indemnity language vary across clouds? @liam-ops can you provision a staging bucket by tomorrow?
kevin-legal: Azure has a slightly different indemnity phrasing; I have a checklist and sample redlines. Attaching doc by noon.
aj-devrel: Packaging convention request: one tar.gz with docs/, images/, manifest.json. Manifest schema v3 requires `pricing` and `trial_policy`. Example snippet:
```
"trial_policy": {"days": 14, "auto_charge": true}
```
vivian-product: Agree on tarball + sizes. We'll provide hero images 1200x627 and 800x418. Branding needs marketing review. @sara-partners can you loop them in?
sara-partners: Looping @maria-marketing — maria, can you validate hero assets and provide a short blurb (3 bullets)? Also confirm logo SVG + PNG.
maria-marketing: On it. Send feature bullets and any product screenshots; will deliver assets and alt text by EOD tomorrow.
liam-ops: Staging created: arn:aws:s3:::rw-marketplace-staging-1713579, IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplacePublisherStaging, KMS alias alias/rw-marketplace-staging-kms. Lifecycle set to 30d.
vivian-product: Great — I'll upload manifests + SKU mapping tomorrow morning.
sara-partners: Action items recap: Kevin — EULA redline; Liam — bucket & role (thanks); Maria — assets; AJ — packaging + validation; Vivian — SKU mapping doc. Target: submit to publisher portal Thu EOD. Any blockers?
kevin-legal: No blockers from legal side.
aj-devrel: None from devrel. Will run validation and post logs.
marketplace-bot: Offer validation: 0 errors, 2 warnings (missing alt text for 800x418 hero).
sara-partners: :tada: Thanks everyone. I'll open the publisher portal ticket once assets + PDFs are ready. Scheduling a quick sync 1pm tomorrow to finalize.
